claims.explanation: Correctly skipped. E01 and table2_correlation.md identify the combined 75-model VM/VLM population, information-content ID LCA, OOD Top-1, absolute correlations, and the four severe shifts. R-squared greater than 0.7 and PEA greater than 0.7 are explicit substantive performance bounds, not just grounded table values. Reported comparison relations cannot express those literal bounds or the approximately-zero ID-Top-1 R-squared condition. Comparing LCA to Top-1 correlation alone would omit central conjuncts; the weaker falsifier cannot replace the complete statement.

Correctly skipped. E03 and both Table-4 transcriptions identify nine-layer K-means, 75 source hierarchies, correlations across 75 evaluation models, and all four severe OOD datasets. Mean PEA greater than 0.66 is an explicit quantitative robustness commitment; the 0.5 and 0.3 falsifier thresholds likewise cannot be replaced by relative WordNet comparisons. Reported relations provide no literal reported-cell threshold test, and slightly lower has no specified closeness margin. A WordNet-only declaration would not express the whole claim.

The compound_consistency declaration preserves CE plus WordNet LCA soft loss with linear weight interpolation versus CE-only, all six named backbones, Top-1 accuracy, and at least three strict improvements among ImageNet-S, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and ObjectNet separately for every backbone. It is not an aggregate majority across backbones or across all 24 OOD cells. ImageNet-v2 is correctly excluded from the four severe shifts. The per-backbone ID ImageNet check uses ge with zero tolerance, preserving without reducing ID accuracy rather than allowing the falsifier's greater-than-0.5% weakening threshold. Table5_soft_labels_wordnet.md and E04 supply the variant and frozen-linear-probing conditions; no significance claim is added.

The three conjunctive comparative properties preserve lower OOD Top-1 error for transferable-feature f, lower ID LCA distance for f, and higher ID Top-1 error for f than confounding-feature g. The last direction correctly represents g's better ID accuracy despite its worse OOD performance. Table7_simulation.md and E06 identify the controlled 100-trial Gaussian-mixture experiment, feature assignments, and OOD absence of x2. Direct f/g rows avoid the incorrectly signed Diff row. The scope remains this simulation, not unrestricted causal validation in real datasets, and no missing trial variance is invented.

Correctly skipped. E05 and table14_prompt_engineering.md provide CLIP-ViT32, all five tested OOD datasets including ImageNet-v2, all four prompt variants, Top-1 accuracy, and test-time cross-entropy. Directional comparisons could retain those metrics and cohorts, but significantly improves requires more than the reported-resolution ordering relation, and the evidence supplies no uncertainty or significance procedure. Testing only accuracy, only severe shifts, or the weaker four-of-five falsifier would each narrow the original statement. No expressible whole claim was missed.
